evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/ptyService.ts
evidence.finding: Local node-pty processes inherit the host environment; Windows uses a worker. Each window owns its sessions, and closing it kills those PTYs.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/settingsService.ts
evidence.finding: Local JSON stores workspace, notes, checkpoints and preferences. Capture/activity/history default on, user-config reads default off, automatic GitHub update checks default on.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/sessionHistoryService.ts
evidence.locator: session matching, prompt/conversation parsing and cache
evidence.finding: Read-only local Claude JSONL history supplies conversation and checkpoints; it does not reconnect terminated shell processes.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/terminalBufferStore.ts
evidence.finding: Persisted serialized scrollback is capped using JavaScript string length at 4,194,304 UTF-16 code units, not a byte-based file-size cap. Restoration is read-only text, not a running process.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/renderer/src/components/terminal/launcherCommands.ts
evidence.finding: Launchers type claude, claude --resume or claude --continue into the terminal; provider CLI owns continuation semantics.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/agentActivityService.ts
evidence.locator: startAgentWatcher, snapshot and notification paths; sibling agentParse.ts
evidence.finding: Local Claude processes/transcripts are mapped to panes and displayed as busy/completed/attention. This observes provider subagents; it does not dispatch a product coordinator.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/claudeConfigService.ts
evidence.finding: MCP panel reads configuration and masks secrets; it can write a template but never calls MCP tools. User/plugin scope is separately gated.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/skillsService.ts
evidence.finding: Skills and command documents can be browsed from configured project/user paths and created from templates; actual agent execution belongs to Claude.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/search/searchService.ts
evidence.finding: Local file-name index and content-search workers provide cancellation, ignore policy and watcher refresh. No remote knowledge retrieval is implemented.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/gitService.ts
evidence.locator: getStatus, diff, stage, commit, push, pull and branches
evidence.finding: Native local Git panel implements diff/stage/commit/branch/push/pull. Remote PR API, CI checks, merge queue and worktree allocation are absent.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/checkpointService.ts
evidence.finding: Checkpoint pins a clean current commit and branch; stale checks whether the commit object resolves through git cat-file -e, not whether it remains reachable from HEAD. This is a diff baseline, not revision approval.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/renderer/src/components/review/ReviewPanel.tsx
evidence.finding: Human review panel selects last commit/session/checkpoint, displays file deltas and opens Monaco diffs, with stage and commit navigation. No approval queue or review-comments schema.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/security.ts
evidence.finding: Packaged renderer blocks remote content and permissions and uses a restricted app origin. This is UI containment, not sandboxing arbitrary terminal programs.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/pathJail.ts
evidence.finding: File IPC canonicalizes symlinks and checks project-root containment. PTY commands remain host-authorized and are not jailed by this function.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/gitTrust.ts
evidence.finding: Git command-running repository configuration is gated by session-local trust; automatic read-only commands receive hardening overrides.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/ipc/register.ts
evidence.finding: Internal Electron IPC checks trusted sender, window role and Zod request schemas; this is not a public remote API or human RBAC.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/usageService.ts
evidence.locator: getUsageSnapshot, startUsageWatcher; usageCore.ts buildSnapshot and budgets
evidence.finding: Local Claude transcript token counts aggregate by model/project/time; inferred plan budgets are estimates. Default status-line source avoids background transcript scans.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/usageCaptureService.ts
evidence.finding: Optional local status-line wrapper saves Claude-reported rate/context/model/cost values in userData; no model API tokens or network are used by this reader.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/updateChecker.ts
evidence.locator: checkForUpdates, download flow and GitHub URLs
evidence.finding: On-by-default toggleable GitHub release polling restricts installer asset URLs; automatic installation requires an available valid SHA512 and verifies it. Missing checksum opens the release page rather than proceeding automatically. Functional update traffic is distinct from analytics.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/ptyFlow.ts
evidence.finding: PTY output batching pauses at a high unacknowledged-byte watermark and resumes below a low watermark. This is display backpressure, not agent compute scheduling.

evidence.title: DockTerm: src/renderer/src/App.tsx
evidence.finding: Electron React workspace contains terminal tabs/splits, local chat reading and composer, side panels and shortcuts. No browser/mobile/editor client entry point.

evidence.title: DockTerm: undefined
evidence.finding: Documents free MIT local terminal workspace and separate Claude installation/authentication; signed Mac/Windows and Linux installers are linked.

evidence.title: DockTerm: undefined
evidence.finding: Undated roadmap has stale near-term and non-goal items; live MCP lists/profiles and richer authoring remain future ideas.

evidence.title: DockTerm: undefined
evidence.finding: Documents no telemetry/crash reporting and functional Git/update requests, local execution and limited renderer boundary. Signed-build statement is stale relative to release/README.

evidence.title: DockTerm: undefined
evidence.finding: MIT source licence grant and notice.

evidence.title: DockTerm: undefined
evidence.finding: Packaging configuration names Windows NSIS x64, macOS DMG x64/arm64 and Linux AppImage/deb x64.

evidence.locator: release body and published_at API metadata

evidence.finding: Project-root-scoped local file operations retain ordinary files; readDataUrl previews image files up to25MiB. This is not screenshot capture or a task/revision evidence gallery.
